modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from fitter-Ring Spinning

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work spot
bring the necessary operational tools to the department
meet the previous shift fitter and discuss with him/ her regarding the issues faced by them with respect to the quality, production, spare, safety or any other specific instruction etc
understand the count produced, colour coding, followed in the ring spinning machines
patrol around the machines in spinning department and ensure the smooth functioning of all the machines in the department
discuss with previous shift fitter regarding the issues faced in the machines if any
ensure all the machines are running properly, for machines which are not running and problems if any should be clarified with the fitter, supervisor and operator
check the cleanliness of work areas
check whether any spare/raw material/ tool / yarn / any other material are thrown under the machines or in the other work areas
should question the previous shift maintenance people for any deviation in the above and should bring the same to the knowledge of his/ her shift superior as well as that of the previous shift
ensure the work spot is clean
take over the shift from the outgoing shift's fitter in a proper manner

modules.module_title: Handing over shift to fitter-Ring Spinning

pcs.pc_description: ensure in providing the details regarding count produced, colour coding followed for his allocated number of machines in ring spinning department
provide all relevant information regarding the count produced, idle machines, damaged machine parts if any
get clearance from the incoming counterpart before leaving the work spot
report to his shift's superiors as well as the incoming shift's superiors in case his/ her counterpart doesn't report for the incoming shift

report to his shift superior about the quality / production / maintenance issues / safety issues/ any other issue faced in his/her shift and should leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from his/ her superiors
ensure the shift has to be properly handed over to the incoming shift fitter

report to his shift superior about the quality / production / maintenance issues / safety issues/ any other issue faced in his shift and should leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from his/ her superiors
ensure the work spot is clean
